business_summary: A non-profit organization that funds clean water projects in developing countries, seeking to convert post-purchase e-commerce shoppers into monthly recurring donors.
product: Monthly recurring donation to clean water projects
stated_claims: We fund clean water projects in developing countries.
$20 a month is our typical gift.

relevant_tags.why: Clean water funding aligns strongly with environmentally conscious and socially responsible shoppers.
The primary goal is converting checkout traffic into recurring monthly donors.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Looking to turn thank-you page visitors into small recurring donors.

note_signals.why: Values-driven shoppers who respond to sustainability claims are highly likely to support clean water projects.
Audience specifically responds well to social-good messaging, which perfectly matches a charitable donation offer.
Sustainability-motivated buyers represent a strong demographic match for environmental/humanitarian charity.
Audience responds strongly to sustainability claims, making them great prospects for clean water causes.
Audience responds to sustainability messaging, aligning with environmental/clean water charity initiatives.

gate_reason: The model, price point ($20/month), and audience target are clear and actionable for placement on social-good and sustainability-aligned publisher thank-you pages.
missing_info: Specific geographic areas or countries where the water projects are located
clarifying_questions: Are these donations tax-deductible (e.g., is your organization a registered 501(c)(3) or equivalent)?
Do you offer a one-time donation option on the landing page for users who are hesitant to commit to a monthly subscription?
Which specific countries or regions do your current clean water projects support?
